name: resource-search
description: Instant search for the Resource Center and Press Room: results appear under the field while the visitor types (no submit, no reload), from a compact JSON index fetched the first time the field is focused, hovered or touched. Typo-tolerant prefix matching, highlighted matches, arrow-key navigation, a no-results state. Enter and 'View all results' open the full results page; when it is the current listing's own (same scope) and the page has a resource-cards listing, the results change in place with the filter animation instead of a reload. Without JavaScript the field submits to fallback_url as ?q=.

index_url.description: URL of the search index JSON (the content plugin's /wp-json/ap-content/v1/search-index?v=<version>).

label.description: Accessible name of the field (visually hidden).

value.description: Starting text (the query on a search results page).

fallback_url.description: Form action used without JavaScript; the query is sent as ?q=.

action.description: Full results page for the current scope; {q} is replaced by the encoded query. Used by Enter (with no result chosen) and the 'View all results' link.

action_all.description: Full results page across every type; {q} is replaced by the encoded query.

scope.description: Type key (blog, case-studies, success-stories, white-papers, webinars, compare, press) the results are limited to; empty for everything.

scope_label.description: Plural name of the scope for the 'Search all' prompt, e.g. Blog.
